reuse.why: Puts the closed-account rule into the existing pre-link guard that every provider link function already calls before touching banks, accounts or the sync server.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; no provider gets its own check.

placement.why: The check sits in the shared link-precondition function in accounts/app.ts, which is exactly where the one-link-per-bank-account rule already lives.

scope.why: Focused; renaming the guard to assertCanLinkBankAccount touches all six provider call sites, but that rename matches its broadened meaning.

maintainability.why: One small guard owns both link preconditions, ordered so the closed-account refusal also wins for the re-link case.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six provider link functions go through the renamed guard.

one_place.where: assertCanLinkBankAccount in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Fintegra and Enable Banking link functions.
